subject: shapefile trouble and trouble with plotting x/y coordinates

messages.author: da0332dd8d5899be
messages.subject: shapefile trouble and trouble with plotting x/y coordinates
parts:
Hi all, 
I have a few questions.
I am currently attempting to turn my AKDe into a shape file. 
I have currently used this code (full code will be at the bottom):
 "poly.spotted10 <- SpatialPolygonsDataFrame.UD(spotted10.AKDES$OU)
spdf<-SpatialPolygonsDataFrame.UD(poly.spotted10,level.UD = 0.95,level=0.95)"
 but I receive this error:
 Error in paste(UD@info$identity, " ", round(100 * level.UD[i]), "% ",  : 
  no slot of name "info" for this object of class "SpatialPolygonsDataFrame"

My second question is I am unsure how to plot my lat/long tracking data points on my contours. I used Christen's akde plotting code that worked quite well; however, because the GUESS function for my variogram did not work I went with a modified code that includes my variogram. This code is not permitting me to see my plotted data on the contours (see bottom).. I am unsure if I am missing any information. Also, it projects as meters and I am hoping to switch it to km. 
 ( my modified script):
spotted1.ctmm<- as.telemetry(move.spotted) # telemetry object for use in ctmm package, or use movebank csv
#The variogram represents the average square distance traveled (vertical axis) within some time lag (horizontal axis)
spotted10.svf<- variogram(spotted1.ctmm)
zoom(spotted10.svf) # interactive plots
plot(spotted10.svf,xlim=c(0,25) %#% "month", level = 0.95) # change val and time units
variogram.fit(spotted10.svf, name = "spotted10.varg") # interactive fitted plot
spotted10.GUESSES <- list()
spotted10.GUESSES$OUF <- spotted10.varg
spotted10.GUESSES$OU <- spotted10.varg
spotted10.GUESSES$OU$tau
'month' %#% spotted10.GUESSES$OU$tau
'day' %#% spotted10.GUESSES$OU$tau
# discard tau_velocity
spotted10.GUESSES$OU$tau <- spotted10.GUESSES$OU$tau[1]
spotted10.GUESSES$IID <- spotted10.varg
# discard both tau's
spotted10.GUESSES$IID$tau <- NULL

# fit all 3 movement models
spotted10.FITS <- list()
spotted10.FITS$OUF <- ctmm.fit(spotted1.ctmm,spotted10.GUESSES$OUF)
spotted10.FITS$OU <- ctmm.fit(spotted1.ctmm,spotted10.GUESSES$OU)
spotted10.FITS$IID <- ctmm.fit(spotted1.ctmm,spotted10.GUESSES$IID)

summary(spotted10.FITS) 
summary(spotted10.FITS$OU) # check for the one with the lowest AIC, in this case it was OUF
plot(spotted10.svf, CTMM=spotted10.FITS, col.CTMM=c("red","purple","blue"), fraction = 0.55,  xlim=c(0,5 %#% "months"), level=0.5)


# gives a density estimte by taking movement data and model estimate
spotted10.AKDES <- list()
spotted10.AKDES$OU <- akde(spotted1.ctmm,spotted10.FITS$OU, weights = TRUE) # for the best model # can use IID and OU as well if required
# home range summary
summary(spotted10.AKDES$OU) # for the best fit model
ctmm::speed(spotted10.FITS$OU, level = 0.95, error = 0.05)
plot(spotted10.AKDES$OU)

# For shapefile
install.packages("proj4")
install.packages('bit64')
library(proj4)
library(bit64)
library(ctmm)
poly.spotted10 <- SpatialPolygonsDataFrame.UD(spotted10.AKDES$OU)
spdf<-SpatialPolygonsDataFrame.UD(poly.spotted10,level.UD = 0.95,level=0.95)

So sorry for all the questions! Thank you in advance 

Mick

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: shapefile trouble and trouble with plotting x/y coordinates
parts:
Hi Mick,

SpatialPolygonsDataFrame.UD taks a ctmm UD object and returns an sp SpatialPolygonsDataFrame object. This doesn't need to be run twice and doesn't make sense the second use.

Something as simple as plot(spotted1.ctmm,spotted10.AKDES$OU) should work, but see help("plot.telemetry") — https://ctmm-initiative.github.io/ctmm/reference/plot.telemetry.html

What projects to meters? The plot functions are coded to switch from meters to kilometers as appropriate, with the default settings.

Best,
Chris
